title: Fresh Lemonade
description: Six lemons, a little sugar, and a lot of ice.
imageAlt: Pitcher and glass of fresh lemonade with lemon slices

steps.title: Make the syrup
steps.text: Heat the sugar with 1 cup of the water until dissolved. Cool.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the syrup, lemon juice, and remaining water together in a pitcher.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Add the sliced lemon and pour over plenty of ice.
